statements.status_notes: Scout reports this timing issue for oauthlib 3.x before 4.0.0; the fixed release is oauthlib 4.0.0, which is a major version with documented breaking authentication and revocation behavior changes. We have not yet completed reachability and compatibility assessment for NetBox's OAuth-related dependencies, so the image remains on oauthlib 3.3.1 until that work concludes or a suitable non-breaking fix appears.

Scout reports this XSS issue in oauthlib through 3.3.1; the only published fix is oauthlib 4.0.0, which upstream documents as a major release with breaking changes (JSONP support removed from the token revocation endpoint and client authentication order changed so grant_type is validated before client authentication). NetBox installs oauthlib transitively into the application venv; adopting 4.0.0 requires validating OAuth and related integration behavior before we can ship a dependency upgrade on this image line.
